title: cestrum ovale
intro: Cestrum ovale, commonly known as the Yellow Cestrum or Yellow Bells, is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms associated with the common cold and flu. The therapeutic actions of Cestrum ovale are primarily attributed to its ability to stimulate the nervous system, promote sweating, and induce a mild diaphoresis, making it useful in treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cestrum ovale include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine.
